start: Owner signed in, gym online, gym server has questions, one member question waiting

steps.action: Open Member questions from the menu
user_sees: Title 'Member questions'
'Members ask from the MettleUp app. Your reply shows in their app, with a notification on their phone.'
'Waiting for your reply (1)'
A card: the member's name as a link, a pill 'To any trainer or the owner' (or 'To you', 'To {name}'), when it was asked, the question in full
must_not: Questions of another gym
A question cut short with no way to read it all
A blank page while reading

steps.action: Type in 'Your reply'
user_sees: Hint 'Short and clear. The member cannot reply back; they can ask a new question. {n} of 1000 letters'
'Send reply' becomes active
must_not: More than 1000 letters taken
The counter not moving

steps.action: Tap 'Send reply'
user_sees: 'Sending…'
The card moves under 'Answered and closed' with '{name} replied · {when}' and the reply
'Waiting for your reply (0)' and 'No questions are waiting.'
The menu count of open questions goes down
must_not: Two replies from one tap
The reply shown as sent when it failed
The reply box still open on an answered question

start: Owner on Member questions; wrong input and missing parts

steps.action: Leave the reply empty or type only spaces
user_sees: 'Send reply' stays greyed
must_not: An empty reply sent to the member

steps.action: Reply to a question a trainer answered a moment ago on another device
user_sees: A red line with the reason (exact words unknown)
The list reads again and shows the trainer's reply
must_not: Two replies on one question
The first reply overwritten

steps.action: Reply to a question the member has just taken back
user_sees: A red line, then the card under 'Answered and closed' with 'The member took this question back.'
must_not: A reply and a notification sent for a withdrawn question

steps.action: Open the page on a gym that is not online
user_sees: 'Questions need your gym online'
'Put your gym online first (Settings → Sign-in & data).'
must_not: An endless Loading

steps.action: Open the page on a gym whose server has no questions yet
user_sees: 'Member questions are not switched on for your gym yet.'
must_not: A red error

steps.action: Open the page with the internet off
user_sees: A red line with the reason
Button 'Try again'
must_not: A blank page
A typed reply lost on Try again

start: Owner with questions in every state

steps.action: Read 'Answered and closed'
user_sees: Answered ones with '{name} replied · {when}'
'The member took this question back.'
'Closed with no reply after 14 days.'
A pill 'To {name} (no longer a trainer)' where the trainer lost the tick
must_not: A reply box on a closed question
A closed question counted as waiting

steps.action: Open the page on a gym where nobody asked yet
user_sees: 'No questions yet. Members find "Ask about your workout" on the Gym tab of their app.'
must_not: Two empty headings with nothing under them

steps.action: Tap Refresh in the top bar while a reply is half typed
user_sees: The list reads again without going blank
must_not: The typed reply is lost
The page jumps to the top

steps.action: Tap the member's name on a card
user_sees: That member's page
must_not: A page for a different member

start: Owner; a member asked one question to one named trainer and another to anyone

steps.action: Open Member questions
user_sees: Each card says whom it was sent to
unknown: whether the owner also sees a question sent to one named trainer
must_not: Feedback or complaints mixed into this page
A member's phone number, body weight or photos

steps.action: Send a reply
user_sees: It shows only in that member's app
must_not: The reply shown to other members
A WhatsApp or SMS sent

start: A desk person ticked as Trainer, signed in, gym online; a member asked this trainer a question

steps.action: Open Member questions
user_sees: 'Waiting for your reply (1)'
The card with the pill 'To you'
must_not: A question sent only to the owner or to another trainer
Feedback or a complaint

steps.action: Type a reply and tap 'Send reply'
user_sees: 'Sending…'
The card under 'Answered and closed' with '{trainer name} replied · {when}'
must_not: The reply signed with the owner's name
Two replies from one tap

start: A desk person WITHOUT the Trainer tick

steps.action: Open Member questions (menu or typed address)
user_sees: 'Only trainers and the owner can see questions. Ask the owner to tick you as a trainer.'
must_not: Any question
Any member name
A red error

start: Trainer with an open question; then things change

steps.action: The owner answers a question sent to anyone, before the trainer does; the trainer taps Refresh
user_sees: The card is under 'Answered and closed' with the owner's reply
must_not: The reply box still open for the trainer

steps.action: The owner removes the Trainer tick; the person taps Refresh
user_sees: 'Only trainers and the owner can see questions. Ask the owner to tick you as a trainer.'
must_not: The old list stays on screen
A reply can still be sent

steps.action: A question to this trainer is 14 days old with no reply
user_sees: 'Closed with no reply after 14 days.'
must_not: It still counts as waiting

start: Two trainers in one gym; a member asks trainer A by name

steps.action: Trainer B opens Member questions
user_sees: The question is not there
must_not: Trainer B reads or answers a question sent only to trainer A

steps.action: Trainer A opens it
user_sees: The card with 'To you'
must_not: The member's phone number, dues or body data on the card
